config: full inference SoC (arty_ddr: DDR3 controller + Ethernet PHY active)
note: Deployed whole-board energy for the GEMM (weight-layer) portion of one SST2 forward pass, averaged over 1000 inferences, meter-bracketed. One forward pass = 196 weight-layer projections = 440.4M MACs = 420 streamed 256KB pages (1,048,576 MACs each). Attention-score, softmax, normalization, embeddings and the classifier head are activation-domain and outside the accelerator's scope (see paper 7.4), so this is the accelerator's contribution to an inference, not total system energy. Streams the resident representative-sparsity (~0.31 zero_frac) weight window PASSES times; per-page streaming energy is weight-independent to first order. Reconciles with the per-GEMM figure: 420 x 737uJ = 309.7mJ (tc-energy-ddr.json).
